tools.name: set_balance
tools.description: Set today's bank balance (the projection's starting point) and optionally the currency symbol.

tools.name: add_recurring
tools.description: Add or replace a recurring item: negative amount = bill (rent, subscription), positive = income (retainer). every_days default 30; next = first date it lands.

amount.description: number or string; negative for bills

tools.name: remove_recurring
tools.description: Remove a recurring item by name.

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Project the balance week by week (default 13 weeks): typical spend from the ledger, unpaid invoices landing on their due dates, recurring items. Chart is draggable for what-ifs.
